title: Transactions per kind
statementMd:
For each transaction kind show the count and the total amount rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `kind`, `n`, `total`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT kind, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total FROM transactions GROUP BY kind;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
